description:
The Raneys help people fix failing gardens with toxic soil, bring “dead” growing spaces back to life, turn neglected plots into food-producing spots, get crops growing again after big setbacks, and come up with clever ways to grow food even in crazy volcanic conditions.
#HomesteadRescue #Discovery

Stream Homestead Rescue on Discovery+ ► https://www.discoveryplus.com/show/homestead-rescue

About Homestead Rescue:
Marty, Matt and Misty Raney use their building, farming and hunting expertise to help people who strive to live off the grid.
